note: Approved Week 8 roasts. 97.66 replaces a rounded 97, the Bibi's margin is 31.7, and Maye was favored by 6.9. Future weeks come from lib/commentary.ts.

matchups.headline: Kabul FC 114.92 – Easy Peasy Lemon Squeezy 97.66
matchups.roast:
ESPN had Easy Peasy as a 23-point favorite. They scored 97.66.
That's not a bad week. That's the kind of collapse that makes people wonder if you're actually managing the team or just letting it sit there. Kabul FC didn't do anything special and still walked away with the win. Easy Peasy had the numbers and still looked like a team that doesn't know what it's doing.
matchups.tag: UPSET ALERT: Easy Peasy was a 23-point favorite and scored 97.66.

matchups.headline: Sandusky's Soldiers 128.48 – Smert Fellas 95.1
matchups.roast:
2-6 and 95 points.
At this point the record isn't unlucky anymore. Sandusky's beat them by 33 without needing a career week. Smert Fellas keep putting up scores that belong in the bottom of the league, and the name is starting to feel like a self-own. If the next few weeks look like this, the season's already over.
matchups.tag: LOCK: 2-6 and 95 points. The margin was 33.4.

matchups.headline: All Heart 120.64 – Jahmyr I Go Again 103.68
matchups.roast:
Jahmyr was projected to win by 20 and lost by 17.
Both teams are still 4-4, so the standings didn't move, but the gap between what Jahmyr was supposed to do and what they actually did is ugly. All Heart was the lower projection and still looked like the better team. Jahmyr got the favorable number and still got outplayed.
matchups.tag: UPSET ALERT: Jahmyr was favored by 20.1 and lost by 17.0.

matchups.headline: Bibi's Boys 147.78 – Chewy's Warriors 116.1
matchups.roast:
Chewy's was the slight favorite. Bibi's won by 31.7.
7-1 teams don't usually need gifts, but Chewy's handed them one anyway. 116 points against a team that scored 148 is just getting run over. The projection thought this would be close. The actual game said Chewy's wasn't in it.
matchups.tag: UPSET ALERT: Chewy's was favored by 6.7. Bibi's won by 31.7.

matchups.headline: Maye i give you a blowj0b 179.26 – Dimes McSorley 89.36
matchups.roast:
179 to 89.
Dimes was 5-3 and still walked into one of the biggest losses of the week. Maye was favored by 6.9 and put up a score that made the rest of the league look small. Dimes is still above .500, but this one was a public reminder that the floor is a lot lower than the record suggests. 89 points against that is just getting embarrassed.
matchups.tag: LOCK: 179.26 to 89.36. Maye was favored by 6.9 and won by 89.9.
